verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a wait-for-selector option or any equivalent wait condition on the scrape API. The nearby evidence covers related but different capabilities: general JS-heavy page coverage, post-scrape interaction (click, fill forms), and managed browser sessions. Waiting on a specific selector before the page is returned is undocumented here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the API wait for a specific selector to appear before returning the rendered page
